items.name: Everest Base Camp Trek
items.description: The classic route through the Khumbu: Lukla to Namche Bazaar, over the Tengboche ridge and up the Ngozumpa moraine to the foot of the Khumbu Icefall, with a climb to Kala Patthar for the Everest panorama.

items.name: Annapurna Circuit
items.description: A long loop around the Annapurna massif that climbs through apple orchards and pine forest to the Thorong La pass at 5,416 m, then drops fast into the Mustang desert and back to the Pokhara valley.

items.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
items.description: A compact trek up the Modi Khola to the Annapurna Sanctuary, passing bamboo jungle, the stone stairs of Ulleri and the rhododendron villages around Chhomrong before the glacier bowl opens out.

items.name: Poon Hill Loop
items.description: The short Ghorepani classic: stone stairs from Nayapul through Tikhedhunga and Ulleri to rhododendron forest, ending on the Poon Hill ridge with Dhaulagiri and Annapurna south at sunrise.

items.name: Langtang Valley Trek
items.description: A valley trek north from Syabrubesi along the Langtang Khola, climbing through Tamang villages and forest to Kyanjin Gompa, with optional height on Tserko Ri for a full 360-degree ridge view.

items.name: Chitwan Jungle Walk
items.description: A guided lowland walk on foot from Sauraha into sal grassland and riverine forest, looking for rhino tracks, gharial basking sites and birdlife along the Rapti at first and last light.
